versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei-kuaishou-public-scraper:

- Provides a one-stop solution for video transcription, cleaning, and content generation from public video links or local files.
- Supports direct CLI commands to transcribe video/audio, summarize content, rewrite as Xiaohongshu-style copy, extract key quotes, or translate to English.
- Utilizes a semantic-level large model for accurate transcription with automatic removal of redundancies and filler words.
- Offers flexible prompt customization for diverse output scenarios.
- Requires a GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN environment variable for usage and only communicates with https://www.guaikei.com for data security.
- Comprehensive documentation included for usage scenarios, limitations, setup, and best practices.
